method: Dated primary-document review; fit/minimal-setup are bounded editorial inferences, not installed-app, migration or comparative usability tests.

selectionChange.reason: Logseq remains held: current generic identity spans file/DB versions and multi-workflow positioning; insufficient edition-specific evidence for this strict note-focus review. Simplenote documents a note/tag workflow. No false Logseq claim is inferred.

description: Compare basic personal note capture, editing and organization in Joplin, Obsidian and Simplenote without configuring structured databases or plugins. Notion itself also supports ordinary pages; simplicity is a workflow fit, not a measured speed advantage or complete feature replacement. Local notebooks, Markdown vaults and account-based sync have different setup and data-handling limits. Draft review; publication is not approved.

newProduct.name: Simplenote
newProduct.shortDescription: Text notes with tags and automatic account-based synchronization; no file attachments.

candidates.scopeDescription: Native desktop personal notebook and note capture/editing. No custom database, plugin or server is needed for this documented local flow. Markdown and optional sync require separate learning/setup; this is not Notion database, team-workspace or migration parity.

attributes.value: Free core desktop notes; optional paid Joplin Cloud synchronization and sharing plans have separate limits.

Compare personal notebook/Markdown notes. Migration and multi-device synchronization need separate setup; paid Cloud services have plan limits. No complete Notion database or team-workspace parity is established.

candidates.scopeDescription: Native desktop personal text notes in a named local vault, without community plugins or custom database configuration. Vault/Markdown concepts need learning; optional extensions, Sync and Publish add separate complexity or cost. No full Notion parity or tested migration is implied.

attributes.value: Free core application with no sign-up; Sync and Publish are optional paid services.

Local vault and Markdown note concepts require learning. Optional Sync and Publish are paid services; community extensions may add complexity. This compares basic personal notes, not full Notion databases or tested migration.

candidates.scopeDescription: Personal text-note editing and tag organization in the official desktop app after account signup. No custom database, plugin or server deployment is required for this documented flow. Signup/email verification and service connectivity are setup prerequisites; this does not promise local-only operation or Notion parity.

attributes.value: Free note application and synchronization service.
Account and email verification required. Notes sync to the service and are not encrypted at rest; attachments are unsupported. Offline editing requires prior sign-in/download. No full Notion parity.
